description: This file defines the ADODB2_mssql class, which extends the ADODB_DataDict class to provide Microsoft SQL Server specific database schema management functionalities, including generating SQL for creating, dropping, renaming, and modifying tables, columns, and indexes, as well as type mapping specific to MSSQL.

classes.name: ADODB2_mssql
classes.description: A class that provides MSSQL-specific implementations of database schema manipulation methods, extending the general schema dictionary functionalities.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps a generic type to an MSSQL-specific type code.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the actual MSSQL data type string based on a type code.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for adding new columns to a specified table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for dropping columns from a specified table.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Creates the SQL suffix for column definition including default, identity, nullability, and constraints.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Constructs SQL statements for creating or dropping indexes on a table.

methods.name: _GetSize
methods.description: Determines the size/type string for numeric MSSQL types based on input parameters.
